blockingIssues.description: fluxos-cli/src/state/sessionState.ts only seeds and reports persisted snapshot data, while env-backed FLUX_ZELIDAUTH, FLUX_ENTERPRISE_KEY, FLUXDRIVE_MWS_BASE_URL, and FLUX_HTTP_* values still affect the live runtime; as a result, flux state show and flux state clear do not reflect or reset the effective session in configured environments.

fluxos-cli/src/cli.ts hydratePersistedSessionState only reapplies explicitly persisted values, so profile switching does not isolate env-backed auth, enterprise-key, FluxDrive, and HTTP-default state; fresh profiles can report one bundle in profile list/state show while flux_get_state still uses the shared env-backed bundle.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated .factory/library/environment.md to record that persisted fluxos-cli session state, profile state, and the CLI resource store all use the same FLUXOS_CLI_STATE_DIR / XDG_STATE_HOME / ~/.local/state/fluxos-cli policy.
